hooks.name: Review Web Design Standards
hooks.description: Reviews web app TSX files against design standards in steering/design.md, checking WCAG contrast, motion preferences, mobile layout, real data usage, and accent color usage

action.prompt:
Review the saved file against .kiro/steering/design.md. Check:

1. **Text contrast:** All text meets WCAG AA minimum (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text)
2. **Motion:** Animations respect prefers-reduced-motion media query
3. **Mobile layout:** Works at 375px viewport width
4. **Real data:** Every grave/visual shows real data, no lorem ipsum or placeholders
5. **Spectral green accent:** Only used for primary actions, not decorative elements

Report only actual problems as a short bulleted list with specific fixes. If everything passes, respond with "Design check passed" only.
